primary_claim: The BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 vaccine demonstrated 91.3% efficacy (95% CI, 89.0 to 93.2) against laboratory-confirmed Covid-19 and 96.7% efficacy (95% CI, 80.3 to 99.9) against severe disease through 6 months of follow-up.
epistemic_gaps: The study was funded by BioNTech and Pfizer, the manufacturers of the vaccine.
The follow-up period was 6 months, which does not provide data on long-term efficacy beyond this timeframe. A gradual decline in vaccine efficacy was observed within this 6-month period.

The efficacy data reflects protection against SARS-CoV-2 variants predominant during the study period (ending around March 2021 for the 6-month data) and may not fully apply to newer, emerging variants.
